data.long_meaning: The Persian name Nazanin is derived from the word 'naz' which means 'joy' or 'delight'. It is often given to girls born into happy and contented families, or as a wish for happiness and joy in their lives. The name Nazanin carries the meaning “Joyful, Delightful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazanin usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
